source: lab (real recording, Orbbec Femto Mega RGB)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of upper wall region: |shift| < 0.5 px every frame)
camera.view: high oblique, looking down into a room corner; floor fills most of the frame
camera.video_artifacts: background blurred by a "Segment Anything 2 Demo" effect (watermark bottom-right x>1030,y>690); people and balls stay sharp with a faint white halo; frame 36 follows a DROPPED source frame (both balls move ~2x their usual step 35->36 and the frame difference doubles); frames 0-10 are nearly identical (static scene before the kicks); possibly also an irregular step 11->12.

inventory.name: basketball
inventory.role: at rest near person_B's feet (centre ~(829,280)) until frame 11; kicked by person_B toward lower-left; rolls across the floor, grazes the soccer ball (frames ~24-26), keeps rolling and is caught/picked up by person_A's hands from frame ~45

apparent_diam_px.note: grows as the ball approaches the camera; moving-frame values include ~1-3 px motion blur

inventory.name: soccer_ball
inventory.desc: white soccer ball with black pentagons (the white ball)
inventory.role: at rest at person_A's right foot, bottom of frame (centre ~(439,680)) until frame 11; kicked by person_A up-right (away from camera); deflected by the basketball at frames ~24-26 to a down-right direction, slows and keeps rolling to ~(777,526) at frame 48

apparent_diam_px.note: shrinks as it rolls away then grows slightly as it comes back toward the camera after the deflection

inventory.name: person_A
inventory.desc: girl on the left: long brown hair, dark-grey T-shirt, black trousers, white sneakers; face blurred
inventory.role: kicks the soccer ball with her right foot (frame 11-12), then steps forward/bends and picks up the basketball (45-48)
inventory.truncation: feet/legs cut by the bottom border, left side cut by the left border from ~frame 13; head visible (top ~y 95-255)

inventory.name: person_B
inventory.desc: person on the right by the back wall: light-grey top, blue-grey loose jeans, white sneakers with black stripes, watch on left wrist
inventory.role: kicks the basketball with the left foot (frame 11-12), then stands, shifting slightly left (bbox x0 870 -> 790)
inventory.truncation: head and shoulders out of frame (top border); visible from chest down; feet at y ~255-322

inventory.name: back_walls
inventory.desc: two light-grey panelled walls meeting at a vertical corner (x ~560-600 px, y 0-190)

inventory.name: wall_floor_lines
inventory.desc: dark baseboard lines where walls meet floor

inventory.name: grey_objects_left_edge
inventory.desc: blurred light-grey object/railing at left edge (x<60, y 450-650), and a dark round object at the far right edge (x>1200, y~380-420)

static_objects.vertical_wall_corner: x ~562 at y=10 to ~600 at y=160 (tilted: camera roll / downward pitch)

events.what: both balls at rest; both people standing
kicks: person_A's right foot contacts soccer ball (ball starts to move, ~5 px); person_B's foot reaches basketball (ball still at rest in this frame)
both balls clearly moving (first frame of basketball motion); soccer ball still touching the follow-through foot in 12-13
both balls free of the feet
balls come into contact (gap ~0 px in image); soccer ball topmost point of its path (cy min ~463-466 at 24-25)

collision / deflection: soccer ball direction changes from up-right (~(+9,-8) px/frame) to down-right (~(+5,+5) px/frame) and its step drops from ~12 to ~7 px/frame; basketball barely deflected (keeps ~12 px/frame toward lower-left)
balls clearly separated (image gap 0 px at 27, 11 px at 28); negative image gaps at 25-26 = overlap in the image (soccer ball nearer the camera)
VIDEO GLITCH: dropped frame before 36 (double displacement 35->36 for both balls)
person_A's hand reaches the basketball (contact/catch begins); ball occluded by hands 46-48
end: basketball held by person_A at ~(350,545); soccer ball still rolling at ~(777,526)

perspective.ground_plane: floor; both balls roll on it, so ball image y increases with proximity to the camera
perspective.apparent_size_trend: basketball D 53 px (rest, far) -> ~72 px (f44-46, near); soccer D 69 px (rest, very near, bottom edge) -> ~52 px (f21-31, far) -> ~58 px (f42-48)
perspective.use: with f=763 px, depth Z ~= f * true_diameter / pixel_diameter; back-project centre (u,v) with (u-640)/f*Z, (v-360)/f*Z
